tools.name: unifapi_fetch_machine_context
tools.description: Fetch first-party machine-readable UnifAPI context such as llms.txt, developers.md, skills.md, auth.md, pricing.md, versioning.md, sandbox.md, or status.md.

tools.name: unifapi_find_api
tools.description: Find live UnifAPI public-data APIs by platform, category, or task language.

query.description: Platform or task keyword, for example TikTok, LinkedIn, or social.

tools.name: unifapi_find_skill
tools.description: Find UnifAPI Skills by task, outcome, or keyword and return agent-friendly run surfaces.

query.description: Task or keyword, for example KOL pricing or creator shortlist.

tools.name: unifapi_get_agent_context
tools.description: Return UnifAPI discovery endpoints, OAuth metadata pointers, MCP setup URLs, and content usage preferences for AI agents.

topic.description: Optional topic filter such as oauth, mcp, skills, pricing, or robots.
